title: CARBON: UAB Cardiovascular Research Biobank
summary: The UAB Cardiovascular Research Biobank (CARBON) will be a resource that contains biological materials, such as DNA samples, in addition to health and personal information on a large number of people over time. It will be set up so that it can be used in the future as a resource for researchers undertaking a wide range of medical research.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age more than or equal to 18

Exclusion Criteria:

* Age \<18, at screening
* Employees or students associated with the Division of Cardiovascular Disease at UAB will not be recruited due to their vulnerable status and susceptibility to coercion.
* Women who are pregnant or who can become pregnant and not practicing an acceptable method of birth control.
